items.title: Eat a Fish Bit
items.detail: Fish Bits are crafted at a Cooking Station by processing caught fish.

items.title: Collect Wood
items.detail: Prickett's Fort and Sylvie & Sons Logging Camp are reliable gathering spots.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops public team and complete the Daily Operation instance.

items.title: Deal a Critical Hit to an Enemy in VATS
items.detail: Target soft enemies like Scorched at Wavy Willard's Water Park using V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Mole Rat
items.detail: Hillfolk Hotdogs in the Forest region has reliable Mole Rat spawns.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while on a Team and wearing a Costume
items.detail: Join a team, equip a costume, and find Pint-Sized Phantoms near cabins and fairgrounds.

items.title: Use Photomode while in a Team
items.detail: Open Photomode while on any type of team and take a photo.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Find these at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go and Grafton Steel.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Complete Daily Operations, easier with a team.

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build or use a Tinkerer's Workbench to craft any plushie.

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Spooky Scorched appear during the seasonal event; use V.A.T.S. with a rifle.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Obtain from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Obtain from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense populations of Feral Ghouls.

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume and kill creatures at Poseidon Energy Plant.

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get Chems from the Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in a C.A.M.P.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Encounter Spooky Scorched enemies wearing Halloween costumes and masks for exclusive rewards and event challenges.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend event.

events.name: Minerva (List 7)
events.description: Minerva's trader inventory offers plans including Brotherhood recon pieces and Gauss weapon modifications.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double SCORE progress and increased caps rewards from activities.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special anniversary celebration events with unique rewards.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed Scorched enemies appear with festive rewards and seasonal loot.
